description: This shell script provides functions for handling firmware upgrade processes for Fortinet devices, including byte swapping, block size conversions, firmware info updates, and performing the upgrade by writing kernel and root filesystem images to MTD partitions.

methods.name: fortinet_bswap32
methods.description: Performs byte swapping of a 32-bit value to assist with endianness conversions.

methods.name: fortinet_by2bl
methods.description: Converts a byte length to a block count, considering 512-byte blocks.

methods.name: fortinet_bl2by
methods.description: Converts a block count back to byte length.

methods.name: fortinet_build_partmap
methods.description: Builds a string representing length and offset in blocks for firmware partitioning based on input parameters.

methods.name: fortinet_update_fwinfo
methods.description: Updates firmware information (name, kernel, root filesystem offset/length) in the firmware-info partition.

methods.name: fortinet_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process: extracts kernel and root filesystem from archive, updates firmware info, and writes images to device partitions.
